verdict.rationale: The Texas Secretary of State runs an online filing and search platform (SOSPortal), not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, API, or any agent-connection endpoint. The pack describes only browser-based filing, ordering, and searching with MFA-gated accounts, and the filing host's robots.txt blocks AI agents by name.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
